description: Asks how CInt, CLng, CByte, Int, Fix and Round treat halves, neighbours of halves and range-boundary halves (round-half-even, truncation, overflow and its phase). Each literal is its own SELECT, then CInt/CLng of the stored Double 2.5, then CInt([px]) through an undeclared parameter with R8 2.5, its two adjacent Double payloads, -2.5, 3.5, 32767.5, Currency 2.5 and the BSTR "2.5". Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
